summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of new full-width 'Bayimiz Olmak İster misiniz?' banner + mobile header logo font revert. All 7 requested checks PASSED on live URL. Bayi section exists on '/', is placed between Solutions and Blog sections, CTA is a WhatsApp anchor with correct href/target/rel, map image loads (naturalWidth=868), red diagonal accent visible on desktop and hidden on mobile, mobile subtitle and CTA readable, header logo font-family reverted to system stack (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont...), mobile header still red with white logo, Amazon marketplaces link intact. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is ~860 lines and mixes hero, products, marketplaces, quiz, bayi map (react-leaflet), contact form, blog sliders — consider splitting into feature components for maintainability (already partially done for BayiOl/MarketplacesSection).

BayiOl CTA visible text via textContent is 'Hemen Başvur'; test spec expected 'HEMEN BAŞVUR' — visually it renders uppercase because of Tailwind 'uppercase' class, so acceptable, but if any downstream test asserts DOM text strictly, consider writing it as 'HEMEN BAŞVUR' in JSX.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BayiOl banner verified at desktop 1440 and mobile 390. Diagonal accent is a div with clipPath polygon, hidden below lg. Map is lazy-loaded (/bayi-map.webp) — scroll into view before checking naturalWidth. Mobile header retains red gradient with white logo; logo font-family reverted from Poppins to system stack. Amazon marketplace link unchanged.
